sources.text:
# StockFlow

Order, inventory, and fulfillment platform for a tea shop. Monorepo (npm workspaces).

## Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Web[React / Vite] -->|REST + JWT| API[Express API]
  Web -->|Socket.IO| API
  API --> PG[(PostgreSQL 16)]
  API --> Redis[(Redis 7)]
  API -->|Outbox rows| PG
  Worker[BullMQ worker] --> PG
  Worker --> Redis
  Worker -->|emails| Mailpit[Mailpit SMTP]
  Stripe[Stripe test] -->|webhooks| API
  Worker -->|Redis adapter| API
```

Checkout reserves stock with `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` in one transaction, writes an outbox row in the same transaction, then creates a Stripe PaymentIntent. The worker publishes outbox events to BullMQ; consumers create pick tasks, send mail, and broadcast dashboard events.

## Setup

Requires Node 20+ and Docker.

```bash
cp .env.example .env
npm install
npx prisma generate
docker compose up postgres redis mailpit -d
npx prisma migrate deploy
npm run db:seed
npm run dev:api      # terminal 2
npm run dev:worker   # terminal 3
npm run dev:web      # terminal 4
```

Or run the full stack:

```bash
docker compose up --build
```

| Service | URL |
| --- | --- |
| Web | http://localhost:5173 |
| API | http://localhost:3000/health |
| Mailpit | http://localhost:8025 |

Demo users (password `password123`):

- `customer@stockflow.local`
- `warehouse.nyc@stockflow.local`
- `support@stockflow.local`
- `admin@stockflow.local`

## Scripts

```bash
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm test
npx tsx scripts/simulate.ts --n 40 --seed 42
k6 run load-tests/checkout.js
```

## Stripe

Without real `sk_test_…` keys the API uses an in-process stub. Checkout still creates orders; the web app calls `POST /api/v1/checkout/:orderId/simulate-payment`. Point `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` / `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` at Stripe test mode and use the Stripe CLI to forward webhooks for the real path.

## Deploy

- Render: `render.yaml` (API, worker, web, Postgres, Redis). Not applied in this workspace (no Render account).
- Fly.io: `fly.toml` for the API. Same caveat.

Set all variables from `.env.example` in the host. Run `prisma migrate deploy` as a release command.

## Measured pick-path optimization

`npx tsx scripts/simulate.ts --n 40 --seed 42` (real run, results in `scripts/results.json`):

| | Avg walk+pick time PAID→ready-to-ship |
| --- | --- |
| Baseline (cart-line order) | **61.3 s** |
| Zone-sorted pick list | **56.4 s** |
| Improvement | **8.0%** |

40 simulated orders, seed 42. Walk cost is a function of zone (A=8, B=14, C=22, D=30) plus 4s per pick.
